_comment: Hand-written evaluation contracts. For each clause heading, must_mention lists concepts the plain version must keep; each concept is a list of acceptable words (any one counts, case-insensitive). Numbers are checked separately by app/llm/facts.py. expect_unsure lists clauses that are genuinely ambiguous, where the right behaviour is self_check=true. expect_context lists concepts that can only come from elsewhere in the contract (definitions, party names), i.e. what document-context retrieval is for. rental_agreement_dense (added 2026-11-07) follows the layout of a common Indian rental template: a dense preamble (S/o, 'hereinafter jointly and severally called', heirs and successors, WHEREAS recitals), 'That the ...' clauses, an annexure and a signature page, which the earlier contracts lacked.

documents.name: rental_agreement
documents.text:
This Leave and Licence Agreement is made on 1 April 2026 between Ravi Kumar, residing at 14 MG Road, Pune (hereinafter the "Licensor"), and Priya Shah, residing at 7 FC Road, Pune (hereinafter the "Licensee").

1. Definitions
"Premises" means the flat bearing No. 302, Sunrise Apartments, Baner, Pune.
"Licence Fee" means the monthly sum payable under Clause 3.

2. Term
This licence shall be for a period of 11 (eleven) months commencing from 1 April 2026, unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 8.

3. Licence Fee
The Licensee shall pay the Licensor a Licence Fee of Rs. 25,000/- per month on or before the 5th day of each calendar month by bank transfer.

4. Late Payment
If the Licence Fee is not received within 7 days of its due date, the Licensee shall pay interest at the rate of 2% per month on the outstanding amount, without prejudice to any other remedy of the Licensor.

5. Security Deposit
The Licensee has paid an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 75,000/-, which shall be refunded within 30 days of the Licensee vacating the Premises, after deducting any unpaid dues or the cost of repairing damage beyond normal wear and tear.

6. Maintenance
The Licensee shall bear the cost of electricity and minor repairs not exceeding Rs. 2,000/- per instance. Structural repairs and society maintenance charges shall be borne by the Licensor.

7. Use of Premises
The Licensee shall use the Premises solely for residential purposes and shall not sub-let, assign or part with possession of the Premises or any part thereof without the prior written consent of the Licensor.

8. Termination
Either party may terminate this licence by giving 1 (one) month's prior written notice to the other party. The Licensor may terminate this licence forthwith if the Licence Fee remains unpaid for 2 consecutive months.

9. Indemnity
The Licensee shall indemnify the Licensor against any loss or damage caused to the Premises by the negligence of the Licensee or the Licensee's guests, save and except damage caused by fire, flood or other events beyond the Licensee's reasonable control.

10. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at Pune shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

documents.name: employment_agreement
documents.text:
1. Appointment
The Company hereby appoints the Employee as Senior Analyst with effect from 1 June 2026, subject to satisfactory verification of the Employee's educational certificates and previous employment records.

2. Probation
The Employee shall be on probation for a period of 6 (six) months, which may be extended by up to 3 (three) months at the sole discretion of the Company. During probation, either party may terminate employment by giving 15 days' written notice.

3. Remuneration
The Employee shall be paid a gross annual salary of Rs. 12,00,000/-, payable in equal monthly instalments, subject to deduction of applicable taxes at source.

4. Leave
The Employee shall be entitled to 18 days of paid leave per calendar year. Unused leave of up to 10 days may be carried forward to the next year; any balance in excess thereof shall lapse.

5. Confidentiality
The Employee shall not, during employment or at any time thereafter, disclose any Confidential Information of the Company to any third party, except as required by law or with the prior written consent of the Company.

6. Non-Solicitation
For a period of 12 months after the termination of employment, the Employee shall not directly or indirectly solicit any client or employee of the Company.

7. Termination
After confirmation, either party may terminate employment by giving 60 days' written notice or payment of salary in lieu thereof. The Company may terminate employment without notice in the event of gross misconduct.

documents.name: services_agreement_hard
documents.text:
This Logistics Services Agreement is made between Northwind Logistics Pvt. Ltd. (the "Supplier") and Kaveri Foods Ltd. (the "Customer").

1. Definitions
"Business Day" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or a public holiday in Mumbai.
"Losses" means losses, damages, costs and expenses, including reasonable legal fees, but excluding indirect or consequential loss.

2. Payment
The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receipt. The Customer may withhold payment of any disputed portion of an invoice, provided that it notifies the Supplier in writing of the dispute, with reasons, within 10 Business Days of receiving the invoice; failing such notice, the invoice shall be deemed accepted.

3. Limitation of Liability
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, neither party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall exceed the total fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim; provided, however, that this limitation shall not apply to (a) a party's indemnity obligations under Clause 7, (b) breach of Clause 8, or (c) fraud or wilful misconduct.

4. Exclusion of Indirect Loss
Except in the case of fraud, neither party shall be liable for any loss of profit, loss of business or any indirect or consequential loss, whether arising in contract, tort (including negligence) or otherwise, even if advised of the possibility of such loss.

5. Service Level
The Supplier shall deliver at least 98% of consignments within 48 hours of collection. If the Supplier fails to meet this service level in any calendar month, other than as a result of a Force Majeure Event or a failure by the Customer to provide accurate dispatch information, the Supplier shall pay Service Credits under Clause 6.

6. Service Credits
Service Credits shall be 2% of the monthly fees for each full percentage point by which performance falls below 98%, subject to a maximum of 20% of the monthly fees. Service Credits shall be the Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for failure to meet the service level, save where the failure continues for 3 consecutive months, in which case the Customer may terminate this Agreement under Clause 9.

7. Indemnity
The Supplier shall indemnify the Customer against all Losses arising from any third-party claim that the Services infringe any intellectual property right, save to the extent that the claim arises from the Supplier's compliance with the Customer's specifications or from any modification made by the Customer.

8. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep confidential all information received from the other party, except information which (a) is or becomes public other than through breach of this Agreement, (b) was lawfully known to the receiving party before disclosure, or (c) is required to be disclosed by law, in which case the receiving party shall, where legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice.

9. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect by written notice if the other party commits a material breach which, if capable of remedy, is not remedied within 30 days of written notice requiring it to be remedied. Termination shall not affect any rights or liabilities that have accrued before termination.

10. Assignment
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, except that the Supplier may assign this Agreement to an Affiliate without consent.

11. Price Review
The Supplier may increase the fees once in each contract year by giving not less than 60 days' notice, provided that the increase shall not exceed the lower of 5% and the percentage increase in CPI over the preceding 12 months.

12. Delivery Costs
The Customer shall reimburse the Supplier for fuel surcharges and tolls incurred on delivery routes outside Mumbai and Pune exceeding 50 kilometres.

documents.name: rental_agreement_dense
documents.text:
RENTAL AGREEMENT
This RENTAL AGREEMENT is executed at Pune on this 10th day of March, 2026 by
and between:
Mr. Anil Deshmukh,
S/o Mr. Prakash Deshmukh,
residing at 12 Law College Road, Erandwane, Pune
(hereinafter jointly and severally called the "OWNER", which expression shall
include their
heirs, legal representatives, successors and assigns) of the ONE PART:
AND, in favour of:
Ms. Neha Kulkarni,
D/o Mr. Sunil Kulkarni,
Working at Infosys Ltd., Hinjewadi, Pune
having a permanent address at 3 Station Road, Nashik
(hereinafter called the "TENANT", which expression shall include its legal
representatives,
successors and assigns) of the OTHER PART.
WHEREAS the Owner is the absolute owner of the property situated at Flat No. 504,
Green Valley Society, Baner, Pune as detailed in Annexure-I, hereinafter referred to as
"Demised Premises".
WHEREAS the Tenant has requested the Owner to grant Rent with respect to the Schedule
Premises and the Owner has agreed to rent out to the Tenant the Property with one
four-wheeler parking space for residential purposes only, on the following
terms and conditions:
NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:
1. The rent in respect of the "Demised Premises" shall commence from 1st April, 2026
and shall be valid till 28th February, 2027. Thereafter, the same may be
extended further on mutual consent of both the parties.
2. That the Tenant shall pay to the Owner a monthly rent of Rs. 22,000/-,
excluding electricity and water bill. The rent shall be paid on or before 7th day of each month
without fail.
3. That the Tenant shall pay to the Owner an interest-free security deposit of Rs. 66,000/-,
which shall be refunded by the Owner at the time of the Tenant vacating the Demised Premises,
after deducting arrears of rent and the cost of damages, if any, save and except normal wear
and tear.
4. That in the event of the Tenant committing default in payment of rent for two consecutive
months, the Owner shall be entitled to terminate this agreement forthwith and take back
possession of the Demised Premises, notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein.
5. That the Tenant shall not sub-let, assign or otherwise part with the possession of the whole
or any part of the Demised Premises without the prior written consent of the Owner.
6. That no structural additions or alterations shall be made by the Tenant in the premises
without the prior written consent of the Owner but the Tenant can install air-conditioners in the
space provided and other electrical gadgets at his own cost.
7. That either party may terminate this agreement by giving one month's notice in writing to the
other party; provided that if the Tenant vacates the Demised Premises within the lock-in period
of six months from the commencement of the rent, the Tenant shall pay the rent for the unexpired
portion of the lock-in period.
8. That the Owner shall be responsible for major repairs including structural repairs and leakage,
and the day-to-day minor repairs shall be carried out by the Tenant at his own cost.
9. That the Tenant shall permit the Owner or his authorised agent to enter and inspect the Demised
Premises at all reasonable times upon giving 24 hours' prior notice.
10. That the Rent Agreement will be registered in front of the Registrar and the charges towards
stamp duty, court fee & lawyer/coordinator will be equally borne by the Owner and Tenant.
ANNEXURE-I
Flat No. 504, Green Valley Society, Baner, Pune, consisting of 2 bedrooms, living
room, kitchen and inbuilt fittings & fixtures and inventory of
4 fans, 6 CFL lights, 1 geyser and 2 mirrors.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF BOTH PARTIES AGREES AND SIGNS THIS AGREEMENT
ON THIS DAY AND YEAR
WITNESSES:
1. Rahul Joshi
(Signature of the Witness)
2. Meera Patil
(Signature of the Witness)
(Signature of the Owner)
(Signature of the Tenant)
Anil Deshmukh
Neha Kulkarni
OWNER
TENANT
